decisions.reason: As a large expanding coding-and-marking supplier, the firm would usually keep a newly launched enclosed manual laser workstation because it extends the core portfolio, supports customized customer applications, and is too early to judge after only one year on the market.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer is close to the established offer and fits the firm's strategy of application-specific, easily integrated coding solutions, so management would normally continue it.

The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer strengthens the firm's coverage of different substrates and production needs, which is central to its single-source positioning and Industry 4.0 traceability direction.
